title: Concept: npm client reaches the network through a cleartext proxy
description: .npmrc declares a proxy URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The proxy sees every request in the clear, including authenticated registry calls, so a hostile or shared proxy can read and rewrite traffic.
risk: The proxy sees every request in the clear, including authenticated registry calls, so a hostile or shared proxy can read and rewrite traffic.
